phase_policies.applies_when: At the start of the game, both sides are in early game with unknown army compositions. You have a heavy economy and technology focus, with moderate production and a light defense posture.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's first tech units or when you reach the early-midgame transition point.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, expand, and keep production moderate; scout with Reaper if available.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and technology while maintaining a light defense. Increase your expansion and production to support a strong midgame.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech/Eco Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to harassment or tech without maintaining a light defense and scouting for early pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: By early-midgame, both you and the opponent have committed to a ground-oriented army with heavy production and technology. Your economy is heavy, and you have a strong expansion.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's midgame tech units or if you face early pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army strength, keep expanding, and continue tech; adapt if opponent shows air or Colossus.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain your economy and production. Keep your expansion and technology development going.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Ground Macro
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting for midgame tech units or early pressure while focusing on macro.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the midgame, you have a ground-oriented army with heavy production and technology. Your defense posture is moderate, and you have Siege Tanks and Marines as representative units.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech units, such as Colossus or air units.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, keep economy and production; add Siege Tanks or transition to air based on scouting.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain your economy and production. Consider adding more Siege Tanks or transitioning to air if the opponent goes for Colossus or air units.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army with Siege Tanks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single attack without sufficient army strength, risking a counterattack while the opponent is also building up.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the late-midgame, you have a ground-oriented army with heavy production and technology. Your defense posture is heavy, and you have Siege Tanks, Marines, and Medivacs as representative units.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's late-game tech units, such as High Templar or Carriers.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army, add Vikings for Colossus, and keep economy and production; adapt to late-game tech.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain your economy and production. Consider adding Vikings to counter Colossus if the opponent has them.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army with Anti-Air
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground defense while transitioning to air; ensure you have sufficient anti-air and ground presence.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
